channel.title: Touchline Sport
channel.description: Independent football journalism covering Irish football, recruitment, club strategy, ownership, academies and tactical analysis.

item.title: Bohemians to Remain at Dalymount Park Until May 2027
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: Bohs will stay in Phibsborough into next season as part of a phased redevelopment designed to cut the cost of their time away.

item.title: Ireland U19 Squad Features Bologna, Hoffenheim and Strong LOI Core
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: Noel Hunt’s latest Ireland squad stretches from Dublin to Bologna, but League of Ireland academies have helped produce many of the players now moving abroad.

item.title: Lionel Messi Scores 100th Inter Miami Goal in Campeones Cup Win
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: The 39-year-old reached 100 goals in 115 appearances as Inter Miami beat Cruz Azul 2-0, the same side he scored his first Miami goal against in 2023.

item.title: Clearlake Takes Full Control of Chelsea as Todd Boehly Exits
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: Todd Boehly and Mark Walter are selling their stakes for a reported £950m, leaving Clearlake in charge with Chelsea’s stadium question still unresolved.

item.title: Inside Stephen Bradley’s Successful Shamrock Rovers
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: Bradley’s Rovers dominate the ball, move the spare man and make opponents rethink their shape.

item.title: Markuss Strods Earns First Latvia Call-Up as Ireland Question Emerges
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: The Bohemians winger has been named in Latvia’s senior squad after a breakthrough season at Dalymount, with Alan Reynolds flagging possible Ireland interest.

item.title: Liam Kitching Earns First Ireland Call-Up as Rocco Vata Returns
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: Nathan Collins and Séamus Coleman are absent as Heimir Hallgrímsson names a changing Ireland squad for four Nations League games in 11 days.

item.title: JJ Gabriel Left Out by Man Utd After Exit Request
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: The 15-year-old had been lined up to make Manchester United history. Six days after a Youth League hat-trick, he wasn’t even in the squad.

item.title: Inter’s Dario Baccin Outlines Recruitment Plan After Piero Ausilio Exit
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: Inter’s new sporting chief wants to retain the club’s Italian core while continuing the younger recruitment model already taking shape under Oaktree.

item.title: Shelbourne Confirm Keith Long as New Academy Director
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: The former Bohemians and Waterford manager will oversee a Shelbourne academy that has already undergone major investment in facilities and staffing.

item.title: Newcastle United: Why PIF Wealth Hasn’t Led To Unlimited Transfer Spending
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: PIF gave Newcastle access to extraordinary wealth. Five years later, the strange part is that Newcastle still have to earn enough money to spend it.

item.title: Céadach O’Neill Named in Northern Ireland Squad Amid Republic Interest
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: The Arsenal teenager and Everton’s Braiden Graham are both in Michael O’Neill’s Nations League squad as the FAI monitor their international futures.

item.title: James Abankwah Scores First Serie A Goal for Udinese Against Inter
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: The Republic of Ireland defender headed Udinese in front at San Siro as his strong return to Serie A continued.

item.title: Michael Noonan Set for Nottingham Forest Move From Shamrock Rovers
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: The 18-year-old could leave for compensation just months after Rovers accepted a €1.8 million bid from Hoffenheim.

item.title: Sligo Rovers: Can Fan Ownership Still Compete?
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: The Bit O’Red have the history, the support and the structure. What they may not have is the same access to capital as everyone else.

item.title: Liam Delap Leaves Door Open to Republic of Ireland Switch
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: Nottingham Forest striker tells Shay Given “I don’t know” when asked about playing for Ireland after scoring his first goal for the club.

item.title: FAI Opens Investigation Into Shamrock Rovers Over Noonan Transfers
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: FIFA referred agency agreements involving Michael and Alex Noonan back to the FAI for examination under third-party ownership rules.

item.title: St Patrick’s Athletic 2-0 Shamrock Rovers: Ryan Sheridan Shines at 17
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: Stephen Kenny’s side cut the Premier Division gap to three points as Sheridan impressed on his first league start.

item.title: Inside Cesc Fàbregas’ Como Game Model
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: How Como bait the press, manufacture the free player and use possession to keep asking defenders questions they don’t really want to answer.

item.title: Chelsea’s Transfer Machine: Will The New Model Finally Work In 2026?
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: Chelsea are still buying and selling at a ridiculous rate. In 2026, the question is whether all that churn is finally building a proper team.

item.title: Braywatch: The Seaside Club Bringing Young Talent Back to Life
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: Bray were once a proper Premier Division nuisance. Their route back now runs through teenagers, second chances and a ground where young players are trusted early.

item.title: James Callan Named Football Content Awards 2026 Finalist
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: Touchline Sport founder James Callan has been named a Football Content Awards 2026 finalist in the Best New Content Creator category.

item.title: Football Needs More Boredom
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: Why the modern game is addicted to instant reaction, hot takes and permanent crisis

item.title: Who Are Sabah FK? Meet Manchester United’s Champions League Wildcard
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: They were founded in 2017, have already dethroned Qarabağ and scored more goals than anyone in Champions League qualifying. Now Old Trafford is next.

item.title: Grow Your Own: Why LOI Clubs Must Back The Academy
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: The League of Ireland is finally making serious money from young players. If that’s where the game is heading, why aren’t more clubs spending now to produce the next Mason Melia?

item.title: Aldershot Town's Complete Rebuild: 21 Signings, 25 Departures
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: Most clubs call five or six new players a rebuild. Scott Davies arrived at Aldershot Town and found himself replacing practically everyone except the ground keeper.
